random_concept: At nautical dawn on a misty coastal cliff terrace, one visibly adult field technician repairs a torn mesh at a working fog-harvesting station while measuring newly collected condensate, with droplets, collector rows, sea mist, cliffs, a service track, and the ocean arranged in readable depth.
general_knowledge_basis: Fog-harvesting installations use vertical mesh surfaces to intercept airborne droplets and channel condensed water into collection vessels.
A tensioning tool, condensate tube, and graduated cylinder make the repair-and-measurement task visibly purposeful in one frame.
Nautical dawn, wind-driven sea mist, suspended spray, low cloud, and receding mesh rows can create distinct atmospheric planes in a photorealistic coastal scene.
